headline: Minal Somany Discloses Substantial Acquisition in INOX India under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Minal Somany has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares in INOX India Limited, triggering mandatory public disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011.
detail: Minal Somany, via a filing dated 16 June 2026 (posted to NSE archives 16 Jun 2026, 16:19:08), submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. INOX India Limited is a multiplex and entertainment company listed on NSE and BSE. The filing triggers the standard disclosure obligations; the precise shareholding percentage acquired, consideration, and open-offer timeline remain to be established from the full disclosure form.
